recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition layout featuring a vibrant orange-and-red striped upper half with a radiating sunburst effect, contrasted against a sepia-toned vintage group photograph on the bottom half, separated by a thick yellow horizontal band.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm-toned graphic header vs. desaturated photographic footer
Radiating white line sunburst centered behind the primary title
Horizontal layering of text, graphic elements, and photographic subjects
Repetition of vertical stripes echoing the verticality of the group members
coreInvariants: Two-tone vertical striped background in the top section
Sepia or warm monochrome treatment for the photograph
Heavy drop shadows on primary display text
Rounded rectangular frame for secondary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The group photograph occupies the bottom 55% of the frame; the graphic header occupies the top 45%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized display text in the upper center, backed by a white sunburst.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starting at the bold title, moving through the framed subtitle, and landing on the faces of the group members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with patterns, text, and photographic detail.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Orange and Red-Orange (vertical stripes and background)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale Yellow (horizontal divider and text fills)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the top graphic half; low saturation, high contrast in the bottom photographic half.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses ultra-wide, blocky, italicized letterforms
Secondary text uses a connected, upright brush script
Tertiary text uses a wide-tracked, all-caps sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: B and S characters feature sharp, angular internal counters
Heavy dark brown drop shadow to create a 3D pop effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, blocky display face and a fluid, organic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, blocky, mid-century tech/pop aesthetic
Provides the casual, hand-drawn contrast for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen background. Top half: vertical orange and red-orange stripes with a white radial sunburst in the center. Bottom half: a sepia-toned vintage 1960s photograph of a group of people behind a wooden fence. Separate the halves with a thick pale yellow horizontal bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-expanded, italicized sans-serif text in the top center with a white-to-yellow gradient and a thick brown drop shadow. Below it, add a rounded red rectangle containing white script text.

verificationChecks: Is the sunburst centered behind the main title?
Is the bottom photo properly sepia-toned?
Are the stripes vertical and two-toned?
Does the main title have a distinct 3D drop shadow?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent warm color temperature across both halves
Ensure text is legible against the sunburst
Verify the horizontal yellow bar cleanly separates the two sections
Confirm the drop shadow on the main title is deep and dark brown
recipe.reuseFormula: Graphic(Stripes + Sunburst) + Divider(Yellow Bar) + Photo(Sepia Group) + Type(Blocky Italic + Script)
